# 4 bed end of terrace house for sale

> Contemporary four-bedroom family home extending to approximately 162 sqm (1,743 sqft), ideally positioned within the highly regarded Grangeabbey development in Monkstown. Built c.2019, this A-rated property combines modern design, strong energy performance, and a practical three-level layout suited to modern-day living.
